description: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world, and is a Delaware corporation incorporated in 1967. It designs, develops, produces and services the critical wafer fabrication tools its customers need to manufacture semiconductors, whose products are used across personal computing devices, mobile phones, artificial intelligence and data center servers, automobiles, connected devices, industrial applications and consumer electronics, and it leverages the semiconductor capital equipment industry's most comprehensive portfolio of products to connect and co-optimize its technologies. It utilizes a distributed manufacturing model under which manufacturing and supply chain activities are conducted in countries including the United States, Singapore, Japan, China, Korea, Taiwan, Israel and other countries in Asia and Europe.
